ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is

ayahs.en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed
ayahs.e2: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths
ayahs.tr: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

ayahs.en: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up
ayahs.e2: and the mountains will be like carded wool
ayahs.tr: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh

ayahs.en: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds]
ayahs.e2: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺

ayahs.en: He will be in a pleasant life
ayahs.e2: they will be in a life of bliss

ayahs.en: But as for one whose scales are light
ayahs.e2: And as for those whose scale is light
ayahs.tr: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

ayahs.en: His refuge will be an abyss
ayahs.e2: their home will be the abyss

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what that is
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what that is

ayahs.en: It is a Fire, intensely hot
